# UFC Fight Predictions

## KNN Model

This file is dedicated to making and evaluating a k nearest neighbors model to predict UFC fights.

### Preparation

```{r}
library(class)
library(caret)

ufc_model <- readRDS("ufc_model.rds")
labels <- ufc_model$Winner

predictors <- ufc_model[, !names(ufc_model) %in% c("Winner", "R_fighter", "B_fighter")]

# Filter rows first, so predictors and labels stay aligned
keep <- complete.cases(predictors) & labels %in% c("Red", "Blue")
predictors <- droplevels(predictors[keep, ])
labels <- droplevels(labels[keep])

x <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = predictors)

minmax <- function(v) {
  r <- range(v)
  if (r[2] == r[1]) return(rep(0, length(v)))
  (v - r[1]) / (r[2] - r[1])
}
x_scaled <- as.data.frame(apply(x, 2, minmax))

set.seed(12345)
train_rows <- sample(1:nrow(x_scaled), 0.7 * nrow(x_scaled))

train_x <- x_scaled[train_rows, ]
test_x  <- x_scaled[-train_rows, ]
train_y <- labels[train_rows]
test_y  <- labels[-train_rows]
```

### Make Model

```{r}
knn_predict_winner <- knn(train = train_x, test = test_x, cl = train_y,
                          k = 11, prob = TRUE)
knn_prob_winner <- attr(knn_predict_winner, "prob")
knn_predict_winner
```

### Evaluate Model

```{r}
library(caret)
confusionMatrix(factor(knn_predict_winner, levels = c("Red", "Blue")), factor(test_y, levels = c("Red", "Blue")), positive = "Red")
```
